name: Capital Small Finance Bank Ltd
tagline: Well-run, almost-fully-secured small finance bank from Punjab - a steady compounder, but regulated capital constraints and modest own targets rule out a 10x
business_overview: Capital Small Finance Bank, headquartered in Punjab (converted from a local-area bank in 2016), is a full-service SFB operating across Punjab, Haryana, J&K, Himachal, Rajasthan, Chandigarh and NCR, with ~99% of the loan book secured (agriculture, MSME/trading, mortgage/housing).
fundamentals_table: Q1 FY27 PAT +29% YoY to ~Rs 41 Cr; advances & deposits growing strongly
~20% loan growth; Vision 2029 implies ~2x loan book
fundamentals_narrative: A conservatively run bank: ~99% secured book, low credit costs even with ~32% agri exposure, experienced management, ~20% guided loan growth and Q1 FY27 PAT up ~29%. Valuation is undemanding (~10x earnings, ~1x book). But three-year ROE is still only ~10.8% (target >15%, not yet achieved), and management's own Vision 2029 implies roughly a doubling of the loan book, not a 10x.
sentiment_summary: Read the full dedicated thread (topic 190098, 5 posts, Mar 2025 - Jul 2026). Sentiment is mildly positive on a value basis - '99% secured book, ~20% growth, P/E ~10, P/B ~1, experienced management... don't see a reason for it to be valued at Rs 1,350 Cr'. One recurring question is how the bank keeps credit costs low with 32%+ agri exposure (answer: strong on-field force, branch-level relationships, low LTV). The main acknowledged weakness is Punjab geographic concentration and low growth versus private-bank peers.
community_signal: No trusted-roster users; no high-conviction call. A couple of retail 'opportunity in plain sight' value posts.
bse_notes: Not independently checked; nothing adverse surfaced. Recently raised capital, still being deployed (CD ratio has room).
bull_case: ~99% secured loan book with historically low credit costs - a genuinely low-risk lending profile
Cheap for a growing bank (~10x earnings, ~1x book) with ~20% guided loan growth
Experienced, conservative management; newly raised capital still to be deployed
bear_case: Regulated bank - loan books can't compound arbitrarily fast without repeated capital raises
Management's own Vision 2029 implies only ~2x loan-book growth - a 10x market cap would need large, unlikely multiple expansion on top
Three-year ROE only ~10.8%; the >15% target is unmet
Heavy geographic concentration in Punjab; growth lags private-bank peers
verdict_headline: Solid, cheap, low-risk compounder - but the structure and the bank's own targets cap it well short of a 10x
verdict_reasoning: Legacy-108-screen seed (old bucket Tier B 'solid, well-guided growth bank - but even management's own targets don't imply a 10x', frozen 2026-08-15) - that call still holds cleanly under the open-screen thesis
No red-flag tier; the business is fine, it just isn't a multibagger candidate on this framework
Thesis fit 'neither', conviction LOW (a reasonable steady compounder, not a 10x)

four_box.note: Verdict explicit: old call 'solid, well-guided growth bank - but even management's own targets don't imply a 10x' still holds cleanly (tam=no).
